title: Workgroups
name: Name
create.title: Create workgroup
create.note: Every admin of the organization can read it. You can write.
rename.title: Rename workgroup
archive.title: Archive {name}
archive.body: Archived workgroups keep their history but take no new tasks or changes.
unlocking: Being unlocked – the content appears as soon as a member or device of this workgroup has been online.
unlocking.lost: Older content of this workgroup can no longer be opened: nobody who could still share it is left. New content becomes readable for you shortly.
placement.title: Default device for new tasks
placement.note: New tasks of this workgroup run on this device unless someone chooses another one. A device that is no longer assigned to the workgroup counts as automatic.
vm-switch.moves: It moves to the new version as soon as its sessions are paused.
vm-switch.switching: It is switching to the new version now.
vm-switch.hold.checkpoint_due: The files of session {session} are being saved (since {time}).
vm-switch.hold.checkpoint_missing: Session {session} has no complete save yet (since {time}).
vm-switch.hold.workspace_incomplete: The workspace of session {session} is too large to be saved completely (since {time}).
vm-switch.hold.checkpoint_impossible: Session {session} cannot be saved on this VM: its guest refuses to export the conversation and files, for example because it is older (since {time}). Without a switch by hand the VM stays on its version; a switch continues the session without the state of this VM.
vm-switch.hold.capacity: The device has no room for the new VM yet (since {time}).
vm-switch.hold.switch_failed: The last attempt failed and is repeated (since {time}).
vm-switch.title: Switch {vm} to the new version
vm-switch.body: Paused sessions move along and continue from their saved state with their next message. A VM with a working session is never switched; nothing is deleted before the new VM runs.
vm-switch.without: Continue without the state of this VM (what happened there since their last save is lost):
vm-switch.without.fresh: Session {session}: fresh – it reads the messages of its task
